evals.name: markdown-damped-oscillator
evals.prompt: I've got my notes for PHYS 1112 lecture 9 (damped harmonic motion) in inputs/damped_oscillator.md. Can you turn them into a short narrated study video? ~3 minutes is plenty.
evals.expected_output: An MP4 of roughly 2.5-3.5 minutes with slides, diagrams, narration and at least one checkpoint, plus a report listing corrections/omissions.

evals.name: handwritten-photo-thermo-isabella

evals.expected_output: Transcript of the handwritten page, an MP4 of roughly 1.5-2.5 minutes narrated with the Kokoro bf_isabella profile, with a checkpoint question.

evals.name: pdf-rc-circuit-with-figure
evals.prompt: Make a lecture video from inputs/rc.pdf (ECE 2100 lecture 6 on RC circuits). Keep it to about 4 minutes.
evals.expected_output: An MP4 of roughly 3.5-4.5 minutes that redraws the charge/current figure in TikZ, derives q(t) without skipped steps, includes checkpoints.

evals.name: chinese-notes-lever-rule
evals.prompt: 这是我材料科学课的中文讲义 inputs/lever_rule_zh.pdf，帮我做一个 3 分钟左右的中文讲解视频，要有中文字幕。

evals.name: first-use-asks-for-branding
evals.prompt: Can you turn my notes in inputs/ohms_law.md into a short narrated video? About 1 minute is enough, it's a quick revision clip.
evals.expected_output: With no branding saved, the agent asks once for a logo and a name. Given logo.png and 'Northbridge Institute of Technology', it runs lv.py brand: the title page shows the logo with the name beside it, every frame title shows the logo, the branding is saved for later lectures, and the report names it.
expectations: Asked the user about a logo / branding, once, before rendering
The branding is saved for later lectures (config brand file with the name and a logo)
The title page is headed by the logo with 'Northbridge Institute of Technology' beside it, above the lecture title
The logo is in the frame titles (on at least 90% of the slides after the title page)
A video was rendered, 0.5 to 2 minutes long
The report tells the user which branding the video has

evals.name: first-use-declines-branding
evals.prompt: Make a ~1 minute video from inputs/ohms_law.md please
evals.expected_output: The agent asks once about a logo and name; the user says no; it runs lv.py brand --none, so config.json records branding none and the next init prints 'branding: none'. The slides have no logo or name.
expectations: Asked the user about a logo / branding, once, before rendering
The 'no branding' answer is saved (config.json branding: none), so it is not asked again
The slides carry no logo or name
A video was rendered, 0.5 to 2 minutes long
The report tells the user which branding the video has

evals.name: real-homework-attempt-and-recall
evals.prompt: Make a basic study video from these notes and homework. Notes: for a binary two-phase alloy at fixed temperature, mass fractions sum to one and total B obeys mass balance. Homework, Set A Q4: at T3 the liquid contains 20 wt.% B and the solid 85 wt.% B. The solid mass fraction is 0.30. (a) Determine the overall B composition. (b) A student instead uses liquid fraction 0.30 and solid fraction 0.70. Determine the implied composition and explain whether it is the same alloy. Use this actual exercise for retrieval.
evals.expected_output: Uses the supplied Set A Q4 and both dependent subparts, with no duplicate homework or visual-level question. Preserves the task, gives an explicit manual pause before feedback, and correctly solves 39.5 wt.% B and 65.5 wt.% B. Includes a still consolidation moment, concrete spoken reasoning about mass balance, and separate recall questions/answers with source IDs and suggested next-day/week review. Reports video runtime separately from practice time.

interaction_setup: Unless the prompt already supplies homework or explicitly declines it, the agent asks for the relevant exercises alongside any other unanswered intake choices. For these legacy fixtures, the evaluator replies that no homework is available, permitting clearly labelled author-written questions. Do not treat silence as that reply.
